name: Treats for Greatfather Winter
summary: During the Feast of Winter Veil, the performer portraying Greatfather Winter in Ironforge grows tired and asks passersby for a seasonal treat. Bringing him freshly baked gingerbread cookies and ice cold milk earns a festive reward and his warm gratitude.

sections.title: A Long Day in the Seat
sections.body: While Winter Veil has its roots in ancient titan lore and dwarven myths of an immortal figure cloaked in winter's chill, modern festivities rely heavily on the commercial sponsorship of Smokywood Pastures. Stationed by the holiday tree in the Commons of Ironforge, an ordinary dwarf spends grueling hours suited up as Greatfather Winter, fielding holiday wishes from citizens and eager children alike.

sections.title: Baking Holiday Cheer
sections.body: After listening to requests for gifts all day, the resident Greatfather Winter inevitably develops a hearty appetite of his own. Rather than asking for something extravagant, he requests a simple comfort: five freshly baked gingerbread cookies made with holiday spices and an ice cold milk to wash them down. The trade offers a moment of relief to an exhausted festival worker and spreads goodwill throughout the snowy capital.

faq.q: Where do I find Greatfather Winter in Ironforge?
faq.answer: Greatfather Winter sits beside the large holiday tree and the Smokywood Pastures display in the Commons of Ironforge, surrounded by festive decorations.

faq.q: How do you make Gingerbread Cookies?
faq.answer: The recipe is sold by Smokywood Pastures vendors near Greatfather Winter. Baking them requires Cooking skill along with holiday spices purchased from the festival merchant and small eggs gathered from wild birds.

faq.q: Where do I get Ice Cold Milk?
faq.answer: Ice Cold Milk can be purchased from almost any innkeeper, food vendor, or drink seller in major Alliance cities, including the taverns across Ironforge.

faq.q: Is this Greatfather Winter the real mythic figure?
aliases: who is the guy in ironforge
faq.answer: No, he is a dwarven performer hired by Smokywood Pastures to represent the legendary titan-associated figure for the Winter Veil holiday celebrations.

faq.q: What does Greatfather Winter send you after finishing the quest?
faq.answer: Upon receiving the cookies and milk, Greatfather Winter hands you a Smokywood Pastures Gift Pack as a little something for the effort.

faq.q: Can Horde players complete this specific quest?
faq.answer: This particular quest is offered in Ironforge to Alliance players. Horde members have their own equivalent quest visiting Greatfather Winter in Orgrimmar.

angles.text: The quest requires simple culinary skills to mix small eggs and holiday spices into festive gingerbread cookies.
For dwarves, Greatfather Winter represents an ancient legend tied to the titans and winter's bounty, though seeing one snacking on cookies in the Commons brings the myth down to earth.
Ironforge serves as the Alliance's primary hub for Winter Veil festivities, drawing travelers from across the Eastern Kingdoms to the holiday tree in the Commons.
